description: A Node.js script for updating the 'Contributors' section in a README file by fetching contributor data from an external JSON URL, generating Markdown content, and replacing or appending it in the README.

methods.name: makeRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTPS GET request to fetch JSON data from a URL and returns a Promise resolving to the parsed JSON.

methods.name: generateContributorMarkdown
methods.description: Generates Markdown formatted contributor list as a table with avatars and links, limited to a maximum number, and adds a 'more...' link if needed.

methods.name: updateContributorsSection
methods.description: Main async function that fetches contributor data, generates Markdown, and updates the README file by replacing or appending the contributors section.
